outcome: proportion of women prescribed and completed antenatal corticosteroid (ACS) courses
median intervals from ACS to delivery
cohort: The study included women with symptoms of preterm labor and intact membranes between 24 and 34 weeks' gestation.
finding: Antenatal corticosteroids were frequently prescribed to women with a cervical length of 10-30 mm and a negative fetal fibronectin test or a cervical length > 30 mm, suggesting room for improvement in prescription practices for these low-risk women.
